summary: fca-eryxenx relays Facebook credentials and 2FA secret to hardcoded third-party host minhdong.site
details: The package presents itself as a Facebook chat client but its login() entrypoint POSTs the caller's Facebook email, password, and TOTP 2FA secret as a JSON body to https://minhdong.site/api/v1/facebook/login_ios instead of authenticating to facebook.com. The destination is set as the default apiServer in the shipped defaultConfig (apiServer: 'https://minhdong.site'), so any caller invoking the documented email/password login flow silently hands full Facebook account credentials — including the 2FA seed — to a hardcoded non-Facebook, author-controlled endpoint. This is a silent-relay of caller-supplied credentials to an attacker-controlled destination and yields complete account takeover of the installer's Facebook account.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
